lead: Starter prompts for an empty conversation: a heading plus a group of clickable suggestions, laid out as a card grid, a vertical list or a row of small pills. A click hands the item to `onSelect` (usually to fill the input or send it right away).

grid.title: Grid
grid.heading: What can I help with?
grid.summarizeText: Create a concise summary of the file.
grid.explainText: Break down a difficult idea step by step.
grid.writeText: Draft code with tests for a given spec.
grid.planText: Turn a list of tasks into a schedule.

api.title: API Reference
api.item: Each `SuggestionItem` is `{ id?, title, description?, prompt?, icon? }`: `title` is the visible text, `description` a line under it (not shown as chips), `prompt` the text to send on click (the title when omitted), `icon` goes before the title.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.items: The container of the suggestions (grid / list / wrapping row)
styling.itemParts: A suggestion's icon (decorative), text block, title and description
